title: Register a Keyboard Shortcut
short_description: Practice binding a keyboard shortcut to the consuming component's lifecycle.
description: App.vue already uses useKeyboardShortcut to close a panel with Ctrl + Alt + M.
Complete the composable so it registers the listener on mount and removes it on unmount.
instructions: Inside onMounted, register handleKeydown on the window keydown event.
Inside onUnmounted, remove handleKeydown from the same event.
Use the same handleKeydown reference when registering and removing the listener.
You only need to modify useKeyboardShortcut.ts.

hints.title: Reference
hints.body: Pass `handleKeydown` directly to both methods; do not create different anonymous functions.
